messages.subject: reshape
parts:
How to convert:
mydata <- read.table(header=TRUE, text='
Male Female
Hebrew   497    481
Arabic   383    393
')

to:
mydata <- read.table(header=TRUE, text='
    g1    g2    g3
1    Hebrew    male    497
2    Arabic    male    383
3    Hebrew    female    481
4    Arabic    female    393
')

?
